contractVersion.description: Strict semver contract version carried by every wire object. Decoders accept the same major version; any other version is a typed error.

intent.description: Natural-language statement of what the user needs to do.

parameters.description: Inspectable task parameters as an open string map (units, filters, options). Unknown keys are data and must be preserved.

projectRef.description: Project this task is performed in.

targetRefs.description: Stable ids of the entities the task concerns (objects, cases, BOQ imports, scenarios…); may be empty for project-wide tasks.

items.description: Opaque stable identifier assigned by the authority that owns the object.

taskId.description: Stable id of this task intent (client- or server-assigned).

taskType.description: Task type (open vocabulary; advisory well-known values: field-capture, evidence-review, boq-inspection, engineering-case-review, intervention-review, outcome-comparison, solution-authoring, project-administration).
